verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly replaces job-wide credential metadata exports with explicit step outputs and routes those outputs only to the dry-run boundary, harness invocation, and rotation write-back consumers. The review/fix lanes restore provider, harness, format, and credential-path inputs from their authoritative selection/prepare outputs; write-back retains its fail-closed tamper baseline on successful prepares and its existing host-record rescue behavior when prepare aborts before outputs exist. The tests pin exact consumers in both live workflows, exact successful output contents, an empty successful GITHUB_ENV, the pre-change leak shape, hostile-gate routing detection, and the live no-format write-back path. No trust check is weakened, no credential value is emitted, and no reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
